exchanges: We went to the Whewells at Trinity Lodge for 4 days & my wife enjoyed it much, she has been laid up with Influenza ever since & I am now in for it. I am going to Ld Wrottesley’s for a few days on the 5th to meet Bell & Brodie Miller & Sharpey. I have today been informed that the W. & F. have spontaneously determined to increase my salary to £500 & let me have my house rent free, which are very acceptable bonus. they will also put the house in complete repair, but I must add to it if I want at my own cost.— Now I want to add two such rooms as yours only smaller—say 15 x 20.— What did yours cost you?

Your news about you unsollicited Salary & House is jolly & creditable to the government.— My room (28 x 19) with divided room above with all fixtures (& painted) not furniture & plaistered outside cost about £500.— I am heartily glad of this news.—
